permission.title: Bring your calendar events in as to-dos

facts.read: Aido reads only the titles, dates, and times of events in the calendars you choose
facts.hashed: Calendar and event IDs are scrambled on your device before they're sent
facts.oneTime: It's a one-time import. Aido never writes to or deletes from your calendar
facts.optional: Everything else works even if you don't allow access

permission.deniedDescription: Allow calendar access to import events. You can still add to-dos yourself

calendars.title: Choose calendars to import
calendars.description: Holiday, birthday, and subscribed calendars are left out to start
calendars.emptyTitle: No events to import in this range
calendars.emptyDescription: Try a longer range or check your calendar app
calendars.tooMany: You can import up to {{limit}} events at once. Choose a shorter range or fewer calendars

categories.title: Which category should they go in?
categories.description: Pick a new or existing category for each calendar

rejected.capacity: Only {{count}} of {{expected}} will fit. Choose a shorter range or a new category
rejected.nameTaken: A category with this name already exists. Rename it or choose that category
rejected.notFound: Category not found. Choose another category

options.title: One last check
options.includeTimeDescription: When off, only dates are imported and no reminders are sent
options.shareWithFriendsDescription: When off, only you can see them
options.disclosure: The titles, dates and times of the events you chose will be sent to Aido's server.

progress.leaveNotice: You can leave the app. The import keeps going
progress.offline: Sending resumes when you're back online
progress.paused: Paused for now. Sending resumes when you reopen the app
progress.notOnThisDevice: Another device is sending this import. Finish it there or stop it here

result.undoNotice: You can undo this within 7 days. Completed to-dos stay
result.duplicateNotice: Importing the same events again won't add them twice
result.undoConfirmDescription: Only to-dos you haven't completed are removed
result.failedDescription: To-dos already created stay. Import again to continue

toasts.startFailed: Couldn't start the import. Please try again
toasts.cancelFailed: Couldn't stop the import. Please try again
toasts.undoFailed: Couldn't undo the import. Please try again
toasts.permissionRequestFailed: Couldn't ask for calendar access. Please try again
toasts.rangeAdjusted: The date changed, so the range was adjusted
